# What Radarr puts in a database it creates at its first start: the
# quality definitions, the quality profiles, the delay profile and the
# metadata consumers. A recording of its own; same format as
# ../golden/requests.txt. setup.sh removes the fixture's database, so the
# recorder's login finds no user: only the API key is used.
#
#   GOLDEN_SETUP=tests/fixtures/radarr/golden-blank/setup.sh \
#       GOLDEN_REQUESTS=tests/fixtures/radarr/golden-blank/requests.txt \
#       GOLDEN_OUT=tests/fixtures/radarr/golden-blank make golden-radarr
qualitydefinition GET /api/v3/qualitydefinition
qualityprofile GET /api/v3/qualityprofile
delayprofile GET /api/v3/delayprofile
metadata GET /api/v3/metadata
customformat GET /api/v3/customformat
